To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of classical forecasting models (regression models and ARIMA) in the regions that do not have sharp economic fluctuations, and the use of MLP models in the regions with high economic activity, is the most effective.
the MLP model has a greater predictive accuracy than the ARIMA model, but it requires a lot more computational resources.
the most accurate results are achieved when the cash flow is forecasted using MLP neural network.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model of forecasting cash flows using neural network technology.
the application of artificial intelligence technologies to the forecasting of cash flow.
the development and testing of methods for the forecasting of cash flow volumes in the regions of Ukraine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most accurate forecasting of cash flow volumes is obtained using MLP neural network model.
the use of neural networks is preferable in regions where the economic situation is unstable.

the use of the MLP model for the forecasting of cash flow is the most efficient method in the conditions of modern financial and economic activity, where there is a large number of factors that affect the volume of cash flow.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of artificial intelligence technologies in the financial sector is a promising direction for further research.
the MLP neural network model is a good alternative to the regression and ARIMA models, which are used in the financial planning process of commercial banks.
it is advisable to use a combined approach in cash flow forecasting, i.e. the use of a regression or ARIMA model in combination with the neural network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
in the process of forecasting cash flow, the use of a combination of classical and neural models is more effective than the use of a single model.
the use of artificial intelligence technologies for cash flow forecasting can significantly improve the quality of financial planning of banks and other financial institutions.

the use of artificial intelligence technologies in the banking sector is not limited to the use of machine learning algorithms, and can also be used in the analysis of large amounts of data, as well as for forecasting and predicting financial results.
